scripts.db:migrate: uv run python -m alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:ensure-test: docker compose exec -T postgres sh -c "psql -U claims -d claims -tc \"SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='claims_test'\" | grep -q 1 || createdb -U claims claims_test"
scripts.stop: pkill -TERM -f 'claims-worker run-loop|uvicorn claims_backend.api.app:app|phoenix serve|phoenix.server.main|next dev' || true
scripts.dev:bootstrap: npm run db:up && npm run db:ensure-test && npm run db:migrate && npm run setup:data
scripts.lint:backend: uv run ruff check src tests
